description: Implementation of a state machine for Zephyr OS, including functions for state transitions, entry/exit actions, and context management.

methods.name: share_paren
methods.description: Checks if two states share a parent state.

methods.name: last_state_share_paren
methods.description: Checks if the previous state's parent shares a parent with a given state.

methods.name: get_child_of
methods.description: Retrieves a child state of a given parent from a list of states.

methods.name: get_last_of
methods.description: Gets the last child state in a list.

methods.name: smf_execute_ancestor_entry_actions
methods.description: Executes entry actions for all ancestor states of a target state.

methods.name: smf_execute_ancestor_run_actions
methods.description: Executes run actions for all ancestor states.

methods.name: smf_execute_ancestor_exit_actions
methods.description: Executes exit actions for all ancestor states.

methods.name: smf_set_initial
methods.description: Initializes the state machine with a starting state.

methods.name: smf_set_state
methods.description: Transitions the state machine to a new state.

methods.name: smf_set_terminate
methods.description: Sets the termination flag and value for the state machine.

methods.name: smf_run_state
methods.description: Runs the current state's logic and ancestor actions.
